extName.message: Doubak: Douban account backup and page archive
extName.description: English store title. 'Douban backup' and 'export Douban to NeoDB' return almost nothing today, so this listing competes with nobody.

extShortName.description: Short name. No Chinese here — a Latin-script listing that leads with Chinese characters reads as the wrong language, not as a brand.

extDescription.message: Archives the pages as standard WARC, not just an export: marks, reviews, broadcasts, journals, images. Chinese-only UI.
extDescription.description: Max 132 characters. The last clause is deliberate: the panel is Simplified Chinese only, and this listing is what will bring in readers who cannot use it. Saying so costs an install; not saying so costs their time. Left ~15 characters of headroom — a description that only just fits gets truncated by the next edit.
